name: Cracked hill
description: A large grassy hill once thought a barrow, actually a vault turned into a prison to punish its failed defenders and holding secrets that could destroy an artifact.

description_citations.text: "Deepest Night" by Will Hindmarch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jul 2021.

timeline.summary: A vault in a cracked hill was turned into a prison as punishment for the souls who vowed to defend it and failed.
timeline.quote: It is a vault turned into a prison as punishment for the poor souls who vowed to defend it

citation.text: "Deepest Night" by Will Hindmarch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jul 2021.

timeline.summary: Someone must venture inside to learn secrets that could destroy an artifact that may already be in the wrong hands.
timeline.quote: The artifact could already be in the wrong hands.

citation.text: "Deepest Night" by Will Hindmarch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jul 2021.

relations.note: The hill stands in the High Moors.
relations.quote: A large, grassy hill stands in the High Moors, cracked by some ancient stress.

citation.text: "Deepest Night" by Will Hindmarch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jul 2021.
